title: Counts match scheduled positions
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, and let $m,t$ be natural numbers. On input consisting of $m$ false bits, the signed count at the input coordinate at time $t$, plus one, equals the input-head position after $t$ steps. For every work tape, its signed count at time $t$ equals that tape's head position after $t$ steps on the same input.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over Boolean symbols
replaced: For every oblivious machine, reference length $m$, and time $t$, the signed value of the stored input-head count pair over the all-false reference input, plus one, equals the public input position at time $t$, and the signed work count pairs equal the public work positions, including the shifted input origin.
